doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: The Absinthe Bar with Piron, and the Cave
summary: Billie and De De played short jobs at the Absinthe Bar with Piron and Walter Pichon, and at the Cave.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, you work there too? Well, I worked there with Piron.
I went there, when I went in the absence bar. Me and Piron was there.
Who was in Piron's band now? Well, nobody but just Piron and I. Piron and I. Piron and Vowler. That's all I was working in the absence bar.
I went in there with Walter Pichon too. I went there with him from the other times and other things I did.
They never had much of a band. It's more just for entertaining people to come in sightseeing around, you know. But you played there, Diddy, huh? Yeah, I worked there.

How big of a group? Short time. No, myself. Let me see. Pichon. Pilgr된 stuff with된 I just mentioned the boy's name again. Pichon? Pichon. Walter Pichon. I think it was either a handjob or sacks, three pieces. I forgot what I was on sacks. I told that to him, three pieces. But short, short, you know, for a short time. Maybe about a month, month and a half, two, or something like that.
We worked in the cave, too. I worked in the cave. Where is that? That's my grocery store. We had the renovation. I worked in the cave. Yeah, I worked in the cave there.
Pretty place. Kind of like a...
We might cave in the cave. It's Ryan Ross. It's Ryan Ross.
It's Ryan Ross. The cave is I worked in there. Alone? Three pieces.
I'm trying to think who was it I worked in there with.
Piano and drum. Piano and drum. Piano and drumming.
Must have been a sax, I believe. Some sax, I believe. I believe it was.
